title: Firestarter
description: Quasifederal agents hunt a man (David Keith), who can bend minds, and his daughter (Drew Barrymore), who can start fires by staring.

title: Fear
description: A deranged suitor (Mark Wahlberg) torments family and friends of a teen girl (Reese Witherspoon) with whom he is obsessed.

title: Hard Target
description: Hired to find a missing person in New Orleans, a merchant seaman (Jean-Claude Van Damme) becomes the prey of those (Lance Henriksen, Arnold Vosloo) who hunt men for sport.

title: Hard Target 2
description: A retired mixed martial artist (Scott Adkins) is offered one final bout, but he learns he has been tricked into becoming the target of a human hunt when he arrives for the fight.

title: The Quest
description: Sold into the underworld of gambling and kickboxing, a street criminal (Jean-Claude Van Damme) vies with the world's best fighters in an ancient Tibetan competition.

title: Jet Li's Fearless
description: After spending time in a remote village to atone for his past, a martial artist (Jet Li) gets caught in a duel to defend China's honor against his country's enemies.

title: Fighting
description: A scam artist (Terrence Howard) introduces a young man (Channing Tatum) to New York's bare-knuckle street-fighting circuit.

title: The Kingdom
description: A sympathetic Saudi police captain helps a team of federal agents flush out a terrorist cell in Riyadh.

title: Assault on Precinct 13
description: A cop must arm prisoners to help fend off an attack by gunmen who want to kill a gangster locked away in the crumbling station.

title: Carlito's Way
description: Carlito Brigante intends to give up his criminal ways, but it's not long before the ex-con is sucked back into the New York City underworld.

title: Self/less
description: A rich cancer patient (Ben Kingsley) undergoes a radical procedure that transfers his consciousness into the body of a healthy young man (Ryan Reynolds), but when he delves into his new body's origin, he learns that some will kill to keep it secret.

title: The Eagle
description: Accompanied by his slave, a Roman soldier (Channing Tatum) heads to Scotland's Highlands to retrieve the long-lost Ninth Legion's emblem, and in doing so, to restore his father's honor.

title: Death Race: Beyond Anarchy
description: Black ops specialist Connor Gibson infiltrates a maximum security prison to take down legendary driver Frankenstein in a violent and brutal car race.

title: Darkman
description: An acid-scarred scientist (Liam Neeson) uses 99-minute masks to be with his girlfriend (Frances McDormand) and trap gangsters.

title: Tremors
description: Four big worms with multiple tongues dig high-speed around people (Kevin Bacon, Fred Ward, Finn Carter) in the middle of nowhere.

title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
description: The Mexican government hires two handymen (Fred Ward, Michael Gross) to battle huge man-eating worms plaguing an oil field.

title: Tremors 3: Back to Perfection
description: Mutated graboids return to feast on the residents of Perfection, threatening its new status as a tourist attraction.

title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
description: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

title: Tremors: A Cold Day in Hell
description: Burt Gummer suspects that giant worms are being utilized as weapons at a research facility in Canada. He soon finds himself in a race against time to create an antidote from one of the creature's venom to save his own life.

title: Child's Play 3
description: Chucky returns for revenge against Andy, the young boy who defeated him, and now a teenager living in a military academy.

title: Bride of Chucky
